input: Investigate remote volunteer opportunities for digital skills

gold.taskTitle: Investigate Remote Volunteer Opportunities for Digital Skills
gold.taskDescription: Research and identify remote volunteering opportunities where the user can apply or share their digital skills.

questions.title: Which specific digital skills do you want to volunteer with?
questions.description: Identify the exact skills the user wants to offer, such as web development, graphic design, data analysis, social media, or teaching digital literacy.

questions.title: What type of cause or organisation matters most to you?
questions.description: Determine the sector or mission the user cares about, such as education, environment, healthcare, humanitarian aid, or community development.

questions.title: How many hours per week can you realistically commit?
questions.description: Understand the user's time availability to filter opportunities that match their schedule.

questions.title: Are you looking for a one-time project or ongoing role?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants a short-term task, a recurring commitment, or a long-term volunteer position.

questions.title: Do you need the role to fit around a fixed work schedule?
questions.description: Find out if the user has time-zone constraints, fixed working hours, or needs fully flexible, async volunteering.

questions.title: What level of experience do you have in those digital skills?
questions.description: Gauge whether the user is a beginner, intermediate, or expert so opportunities can be matched to an appropriate skill level.

questions.title: Have you volunteered before, digitally or otherwise?
questions.description: Understand the user's prior volunteering background to tailor the search toward beginner-friendly platforms or advanced professional networks.
